name: local-review-workbench
description: Understand a code change, focus your review, and check findings against requirements and existing callers.

interface.shortDescription: Understand a PR and know what to review.
interface.longDescription: Explain what changed and where to focus your review. Check correctness, API compatibility, simplification, and naming, then verify findings before reporting them. This read-only skill uses your current session, configured model, and available tools. Preview; no automatic hooks or hosted service.
defaultPrompt: Use $review-local-changes to explain the bundled compatibility fixture and review its before/after change without editing files. Do not read the evaluation answer key until the review is complete.
Use $review-local-changes on my current changes. Explain what this PR does and where I should focus my review, then report only validated issues and clearly separate optional suggestions.
